It has developed over 11,500 residential and commercial units across cities like Gurugram, Delhi, Mohali, Chennai, Hyderabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, and Indore. Emaar India has a land bank of some 6,000 acres and its projects span residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality sectors.
